title: Open the Gates Room
description: The Tower's Gates Room is its long-distance transit chamber. Establish a Waystone there as the room's first operational anchor. The installed Waystones network supplies the travel infrastructure; this restoration does not pretend that Waystones are recovered Minion Gate machinery, nor does it create a separate Waystones progression chain.
description_completed: A Waystone anchor can now serve the Dark Tower's Gates Room. Further network discovery and ordinary travel remain normal Waystones gameplay.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign

objectives.name: Prepare a Waystone anchor for the Gates Room
